profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Distributed Systems & Platform Architecture | Building Production AI Agent Infrastructure (MCP, LLM, RAG) | Python, Java, AWS/OCI/Azure
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer with 20+ years designing and operating the foundational platform infrastructure other engineering teams build on — API gateways, distributed transaction systems, and cloud-native backend services at scale. Currently building production AI agent infrastructure at Oracle Health: a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, LLM-powered pipelines, and distributed data processing on Ray.io. Deep experience across the full stack of platform engineering — distributed systems, reliability (SLOs, observability, incident response), multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, OCI, Azure), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
Known for taking ambiguous, high-stakes problems from zero to production without waiting to be assigned — architecting a company-wide API gateway platform, a distributed transaction system for financial workflows, and AI infrastructure that didn't exist before I built it. I lead cross-team technical initiatives, mentor engineers through design reviews, and translate business requirements into systems that hold up under real production load.
Currently pursuing an M.S. in Computer Science (Big Data Systems) at Arizona State University. Bilingual in English and Spanish.
Key Strengths: Distributed Systems & Microservices • AI/Agentic Infrastructure (MCP, LLM, RAG) • Platform Engineering & API Architecture • Python & Java • Multi-Cloud (AWS, OCI, Azure) • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) • Reliability Engineering (SLOs, Observability) • Cross-Team Technical Leadership • Mentoring & Coaching

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading the design and delivery of production AI agent infrastructure for enterprise healthcare, including:
• Architected and built a production Model Context Protocol (MCP) server — the emerging open standard for AI agent-to-tool connectivity — in Python, running on distributed infrastructure (Ray.io). Owned it end-to-end: requirements, architecture, CI/CD, and ongoing production support.
• Built an LLM-powered patient summarization service generating structured summaries from longitudinal medical records, with embedding-based retrieval (RAG) and batch/async processing at up to 10,000 records/day.
• Designed HIPAA-compliant distributed microservices on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), with multi-tier data architecture across Redis, Object Storage, and relational storage.
• Own infrastructure via Terraform, Kubernetes cluster provisioning, and full-stack observability (OpenTelemetry, OCI Monitoring); participate in on-call incident response and SLO ownership.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected foundational platform infrastructure for a fintech scale-up, including:
• Designed and led the rollout of a company-wide API gateway platform (Kong), establishing routing standards and API contracts adopted across the engineering organization — reducing latency by 50%.
• Architected a distributed transaction system (AWS Step Functions) to guarantee data integrity across loan origination workflows, with deterministic rollback/roll-forward when multi-step processes failed mid-flight.
• Built event-driven infrastructure (SQS, SNS) enabling engineering teams to build independently on a stable platform foundation.
• Mentored engineers through code review and architecture guidance; drove adoption of TypeScript-first standards and test-driven development.
positions.insights: Skills: Lua · Postman API · API Development

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented synchronous and asynchronous backend APIs for a high-scale enterprise SaaS product, with OpenAPI and RAML documentation.
• Contributed to API design and service patterns used across the team; participated in code reviews and design discussions.
• Participated in weekly rotational on-call (PagerDuty) as an escalation point for customer-facing production issues.
• Mentored junior engineers through Salesforce's formal mentoring program — code review, onboarding support, and career growth coaching.
• Managed infrastructure via Terraform; built CI/CD pipelines and Grafana observability dashboards; used Splunk for operational visibility.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
• Tested and validated a real-time, event-driven communication platform (Kafka) supporting a high-traffic, customer-facing product across a globally distributed deployment.
• Identified an unowned operational gap across a 160+ region global deployment — no reliable way to see what version was running where — and built a version-tracking tool on my own initiative, without being asked. Later rewrote it in Java/Spring Boot; the project justified dedicated engineering headcount for two years after I moved on.
• Built inter-service test frameworks and automated test suites supporting Live Agent's release process across a global, multi-stage deployment pipeline.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
• Built a deployment verification system and automated test framework to ensure error-free production releases at scale.
• Championed CI/CD automation and continuous deployment best practices across engineering teams.

positions.title: SDET II
positions.description:
• Defined test strategy and built automated test suites for Xbox Live Commerce, a distributed system processing financial transactions for millions of simultaneous users.
• Implemented fault injection and failure simulation frameworks validating platform resiliency for financially critical transactions — ensuring customers received paid-for goods and services reliably.
• Built inter-service test frameworks and service emulators in C#, controlling data flow across distributed service boundaries.

positions.title: SDET
positions.description:
• Designed and maintained test plans and automated test suites for Virtual Machine Manager and Operations Manager interoperability.
• Supported test engineering for Zune Services.
• Built test tooling and automated test cases using C#.

positions.description:
